subsEditRemoteHint: 修改链接或收录类型后会立即重新下载，并替换该订阅原有的规则；订阅方式与本地文件不可更改。
Changing the URL or rule type downloads again immediately and replaces this subscription's rules; the source type and local file cannot be changed.
subsEditLocalHint: 本地文件通过系统文件选择器读取，应用只保留读取权限；同名的黑白名单与 hosts 订阅互不影响。
Local files are read through the system picker and the app only keeps read access; allow/block and hosts subscriptions with the same name do not affect each other.
subsAddRemoteHint: 同一条链接可以为黑白名单和 hosts 各建一条订阅（唯一性按「链接 + 类型」判定），保存后会立即下载一次正文并写入规则库。
One URL can back both an allow/block and a hosts subscription (uniqueness is URL + type); saving downloads the body once and stores it.
subsDeleteMessage:
删除「{name}」后不可撤销。

删除会同时移除这条订阅贡献的全部规则（来源标签 sub_<id>）。

Deleting "{name}" cannot be undone.

It also removes every rule this subscription contributed (source tag sub_<id>).
subsRulesStored: 已入库 {count} 条规则；{action}该订阅贡献的规则。
{count} rules stored; {action} the rules this subscription contributed.
subsActionRemote: 更新会重新下载并替换
an update downloads again and replaces
subsActionLocal: 重新导入会重新读取该文件并替换
re-importing reads the file again and replaces
